subject: Art & Design
title: Van Gogh: Genius in the Margins
description: A fast breakdown of Van Gogh: Genius in the Margins for builders.

hook.text: Van Gogh sold only one painting in his lifetime. Today his works sell for over $100 million.

buildup.text: He painted 2,100 works in just 10 years — an astonishing pace driven by obsession and urgency.

discovery.text: His swirling brushstrokes weren't random. They follow energy patterns matching fluid dynamics.

twist.text: Starry Night, his most famous work, was painted from the window of an asylum.

climax.text: His bold color and emotional intensity invented Expressionism before it had a name.

punchline.text: The world caught up to Van Gogh — 100 years too late.

quiz.question: How many paintings did Van Gogh sell during his lifetime?

details.summary: Vincent van Gogh (1853-1890) painted for only a decade, producing over 2,100 works including 860 oil paintings. His thick impasto brushstrokes, vivid color.
details.whyItMatters: Van Gogh's story defines the myth of the unrecognized genius. His emotional honesty and expressive technique influenced Expressionism and Fauvism, proving that personal vision matters more than technical convention.
takeaways: Painted for only a decade, producing over 2,100 works
Sold only one painting during his lifetime
Thick impasto and vivid color influenced Expressionism

faq.question: Did Van Gogh really cut off his own ear?
faq.answer: He severed part of his left ear during a mental health crisis in December 1888, after a confrontation with Paul Gauguin. The exact circumstances are debated — some historians suggest Gauguin may have been involved. Van Gogh continued painting prolifically afterward.

faq.question: Why was Van Gogh not appreciated in his lifetime?
faq.answer: His thick impasto, intense colors, and emotionally distorted forms were too radical for 1880s taste. Critics preferred Impressionism's softer approach. His brother Theo, an art dealer, tirelessly promoted his work, but widespread recognition came only after Vincent's death in 1890.
